forms: simplified 13 Nov 2026: desire expit(a_role + delta M_j + eta need), M_j = other core migrants of the household; receipt expit(b0 + b E), E = all effective senders (one b, 13 Nov 2026)
stage1: independent senders, P = mean_t[1 - prod(1 - a d)]; ML (Nelder-Mead); LR test delta_c = delta_k
stage2: a_c, a_k, delta fixed; eta by Nelder-Mead (outer), (b0, b) by L-BFGS-B with analytic gradient (inner), b >= 0, per kappa; separate b_c, b_k refitted for the LR test of b_c = b_k
receipt_target: MMP remus == 1, mean monthly receipt probability (mapping assumption)
